summary: Keep one Navisun platform and reject the queued duplicate OMERS owner addition. Correct OMERS's legal entry from the November 2021 signing to the January 18, 2022 close, record the 100% Magnet Acquisition Holdings/Magnet US chain, and add Ares Capital Corporation as former owner from November 15, 2017 to closing. Catalyze was only an unconfirmed potential buyer in an ongoing process and does not change current ownership.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The holders of the remaining 45% Class A interests before OMERS closing are not publicly resolved; this does not affect the proven current 100% OMERS chain.
The exact Ares fund or account label beyond Ares Capital Corporation is not publicly disclosed.
Founder or management rollover economics are not publicly disclosed, while the signed transaction scope and post-close regulatory chain support 100% OMERS ownership.
recommendedActions: Keep one canonical Navisun LLC company and treat Navisun Holdings LLC, projects, portfolios, SPVs, tax-equity vehicles and asset-level partners as internal or underlying boundaries.

Retain one active OMERS ownership period, set announcement to November 2, 2021 and legal entry to January 18, 2022, and record the 100% Magnet Acquisition Holdings Corporation to Magnet US Acquisition Corporation chain.
Add Ares Capital Corporation as former owner from November 15, 2017 through January 18, 2022 without inventing the undisclosed remaining Class A holders or a more specific Ares fund.
Do not record Catalyze as an owner or signed pending buyer; retain the 2025-2026 sale process only as unconfirmed research context until definitive evidence emerges.
